authority.statement: The notice and locator grant no permission or authority.

boundaries: This notice is communication evidence only and grants no authority, admission, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production claim.
Fast-lane deferral applies only to lifecycle refresh and receipt choreography during the bounded product loop; it does not waive candidate validation or semantic stop conditions.
Do not treat an existing W3 or W4 aggregate validator pass as individualized candidate closure for all six meta-types without exact current-byte evidence.
Preserve unrelated dirty-worktree bytes and do not stage, commit, push, or use an external transport under this notice.
Do not alter canonical definitions, accepted decisions, Craft authority, public Arcanum sources, or private/public boundaries without a separately authorized owner route.
key_points: The active fast lane is bounded to W3 Operation, Interface, Event, and Mapping plus W4 State Machine and Workflow candidate refinement or closure.

Existing W3 and W4 validators cover candidate-local ontology, profile, provider, descriptor, observation, and relation bindings, but a passing validator alone does not grant admission, promotion, release, deployment, or production authority.
Candidate validation is not deferred: the execution owner must test the actual resulting bytes and return a consolidated validation report with an exact changed-file inventory.

The prior remaining-meta-types terminal receipt closes six different slices at a candidate-only claim ceiling and explicitly leaves governance synchronization, admission, promotion, publication, release, deployment, and production readiness unresolved.

After W3/W4 product validation, lifecycle governance must reconcile the exact candidate evidence, decision and profile digests, Work Pack and Craft projections, and terminal-receipt successor topology.

next_actions.action: Refine only where live evidence shows a gap, validate the actual W3/W4 candidate bytes, and publish one consolidated prototype validation report with exact changed-file inventory and claim ceiling.

After product validation, reconcile W3/W4 candidate evidence, decision and profile digests, Work Pack and Craft projections, and terminal-receipt topology without stretching prior acceptance over changed bytes.
Review and accept or reject any new acceptance-bound successor bytes before admission or promotion.
